components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a screen region, at the bottom right on a phone.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b99257; color: #0c1b26; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 16px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(185 146 87 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0c1b26, 0 0 0 4px #b99257; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #0c1b26; color: #f4f1eb; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #27404f; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 16px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #182b38; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0c1b26, 0 0 0 4px #b99257; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0c1b26; color: #f4f1eb; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #5e7a8a; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 16px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b99257; }

components.name: Open Time
components.description: An open meeting time on the board; tapping it holds it.
components.css: .ds-time { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: 80px; width: 160px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #0c1b26; color: #f4f1eb; border: 1px solid #b99257; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-time-t { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-time-d { font-size: 14px; } .ds-time:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b99257; }

components.name: Held Time (mine)
components.description: The time this person is holding.
components.css: .ds-time-held { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: 80px; width: 160px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #b99257; color: #0c1b26; border: 1px solid #b99257; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-time-held .ds-time-t { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-time-held .ds-time-d { font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: A small, steady warm light on a deep navy evening. The app is used at dusk, by a company that sells light, so the screen behaves like a porch light: dark and quiet by default, with gold appearing only where the next thing to do is. Everything else steps back. It is calm and premium through restraint: flat surfaces, plain words, generous spacing and big targets, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default (night navy), with a light theme each device remembers; PDFs are always white.
Gold marks the primary action, the current step and the time someone is holding, nothing else.
Flat surfaces separated by borders and tonal steps, not shadows.
One sans (Manrope), bold for headings and times, tabular figures for times.
Every control is at least 44 px tall; the next step sits at the bottom right in thumb reach.

rules.name: The Porch Light Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the next action is: the primary button, the held time, the current step or the selected evening. If two things on a screen are gold, one of them is wrong.

dos: Do keep the next action at the bottom right, in thumb reach, at least 44 px tall.
Do use gold for one thing per screen region: the action, the held time or the current step.
Do write empty states that say what will appear and how to make it appear.
Do show times in Calgary time with tabular figures.
donts: Don't use emoji, gradients, glassy effects, icon grids or filler.
Don't show colour swatches for track or soffit colours; show names.
Don't put anything important at the top centre of a phone screen.
Don't use gold for body text on a light background.
